name: 55-config-provenance
prompt: `sh run.sh` runs this service with the staging profile and prints a timeout of 4500ms, but staging is supposed to run at 3000ms. Nothing in the repository contains the number 4500: work out where it comes from and make staging print `timeout_ms=3000` instead. Constraints: do not modify config/defaults.go; `APP_PROFILE=prod` must keep printing 3000; a profile that sets its own timeout_ms must still win (a profile file with only `{"timeout_ms": 1234}` must produce 1234); the scaling mechanism must survive, so a profile of `{"timeout_ms": 1000, "timeout_scale": 2}` must still produce 2000; `APP_TIMEOUT_MS` must still override everything; staging must keep region `eu` and retries must stay 3 everywhere. Then write into ANSWER.txt one single line, and nothing else, naming the config file and the key that multiplied the timeout, in the form `<path>:<key>` with the path relative to this directory.
check:
set -u
fail() { echo "FAIL: $1"; exit 1; }
cmp config/defaults.go .eval/defaults.go || fail "config/defaults.go was modified"
test -f ANSWER.txt || fail "no ANSWER.txt"
ans=$(tr -d ' \t\r' < ANSWER.txt | grep -c .)
test "$ans" = 1 || fail "ANSWER.txt must hold exactly one non-empty line, has $ans"
got=$(tr -d ' \t\r' < ANSWER.txt | grep . | head -1)
test "$got" = "profiles/staging.json:timeout_scale" || fail "ANSWER.txt = $got"
run() { env APP_PROFILE="$1" APP_TIMEOUT_MS="$2" sh run.sh 2>&1; }
out=$(env APP_PROFILE=staging sh run.sh 2>&1) || fail "staging run failed: $out"
test "$out" = "timeout_ms=3000 retries=3 region=eu" || fail "staging: $out"
out=$(env APP_PROFILE=prod sh run.sh 2>&1) || fail "prod run failed: $out"
test "$out" = "timeout_ms=3000 retries=3 region=us" || fail "prod: $out"
printf '{"timeout_ms": 1234}\n' > profiles/probe.json
out=$(env APP_PROFILE=probe sh run.sh 2>&1) || fail "probe run failed: $out"
test "$out" = "timeout_ms=1234 retries=3 region=us" || fail "probe profile no longer wins: $out"
printf '{"timeout_ms": 1000, "timeout_scale": 2}\n' > profiles/probe2.json
out=$(env APP_PROFILE=probe2 sh run.sh 2>&1) || fail "probe2 run failed: $out"
test "$out" = "timeout_ms=2000 retries=3 region=us" || fail "timeout_scale no longer scales: $out"
out=$(run staging 999) || fail "env override run failed: $out"
test "$out" = "timeout_ms=999 retries=3 region=eu" || fail "APP_TIMEOUT_MS no longer wins: $out"
exit 0
